metaDescription: Order custom reflective caps for safety or branding. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get your quote today!
introHtml: Custom reflective caps combine visibility with brand promotion, making them a practical choice for safety managers and marketing directors alike. Whether you need caps for a construction crew, a running event, or an evening outdoor activation, the reflective elements ensure your logo stays seen in low light. Choose from classic snapbacks or performance mesh styles, and add your logo through screen printing or embroidery. These caps work well for uniform programs, giveaways at night races, or any scenario where safety and branding go hand in hand.
heroAltText: Custom reflective caps with silver reflective strips on front and sides, ideal for safety and branding
